decision_basis.narrative: 决策主要建立在种子告警后的重复外联、同基础设施复现以及后续执行线索之上。
decision_basis.focus_statement: web-app-01、app-db-01 围绕 198.51.100.88、cdn-auth-check.net 的重复外联已经延伸到主机侧执行，事件闭环已经基本形成。
decision_basis.positive_summary: web-app-01、app-db-01 先围绕 198.51.100.88、cdn-auth-check.net 形成重复外联，随后又出现主机侧执行痕迹，因此判断已经超过单点命中。
decision_basis.counter_summary: 反证主要来自维护窗口、签名更新以及兄弟资产同步访问，这些背景足以解释为什么不能只凭 seed alert 直接定性。

positive_signals.summary: Seed JA4 alert matched a possible web-shell beacon over TLS.
positive_signals.detail: web-app-01 -> 198.51.100.88 / cdn-auth-check.net: Seed JA4 alert matched a possible web-shell beacon over TLS.
positive_signals.why_it_matters: 这是种子命中的直接落点，说明告警并不是孤立的指纹命中。

positive_signals.summary: The web server resolved cdn-auth-check.net shortly after the exploit attempts.
positive_signals.detail: web-app-01 -> cdn-auth-check.net: The web server resolved cdn-auth-check.net shortly after the exploit attempts.
positive_signals.why_it_matters: 它给出了可疑外联之前的解析准备动作，说明相关基础设施不是只在告警瞬间出现。

positive_signals.summary: The same web server reconnected to the same external infrastructure after the seed alert.
positive_signals.detail: web-app-01 -> 198.51.100.88 / cdn-auth-check.net: The same web server reconnected to the same external infrastructure after the seed alert.
positive_signals.why_it_matters: 同一资产围绕同一批外部基础设施再次通信，单条告警已经扩展成连续事件链。

positive_signals.summary: SMB connection from web-app-01 to app-db-01 followed the web-shell and PowerShell activity.
positive_signals.detail: web-app-01 -> 10.60.2.34: SMB connection from web-app-01 to app-db-01 followed the web-shell and PowerShell activity.
positive_signals.why_it_matters: 这条记录把可疑外联推进到了主机侧执行层，显著提高了事件成立概率。

positive_signals.summary: app-db-01 contacted the original external infrastructure after the lateral movement signal.

positive_signals.why_it_matters: 它说明可疑通信具备复现性，不像一次性噪声。

- 本节目标：只收敛结论、严重度、把握度、已确认受影响范围和立即动作，不展开附录型对象清单；如果当前只有调查锚点而没有已确认受影响资产，不要把调查锚点改写成已确认影响范围。
- 可引用 packets：verdict_packet；scope_packet；action_packet
- 优先引用事实 ID（按顺序）：fact-event-evt-301；fact-event-evt-303；fact-event-evt-304；fact-scope-obj-02；fact-scope-obj-03
### 1. 事件背景与已知线索

- 可引用 packets：verdict_packet；scope_packet
- 优先引用事实 ID（按顺序）：fact-event-evt-303；fact-event-evt-304；fact-scope-obj-01；fact-scope-obj-03；fact-scope-obj-04
### 2. 范围界定与调查假设
- 本节目标：说明调查锚点、已确认受影响范围和待确认对象各落在哪里，以及为什么边界停在这里。
- 可引用 packets：scope_packet；constraint_packet
- 优先引用事实 ID（按顺序）：fact-scope-obj-01；fact-scope-obj-02；fact-scope-obj-03；fact-scope-obj-04；fact-scope-obj-12；fact-gap-expand_cluster_scope
### 3. 对象覆盖策略与关键实体
- 本节目标：区分调查锚点、已确认受影响对象、待确认对象、核心外部基础设施和背景指标，只点关键对象。
- 可引用 packets：scope_packet
- 优先引用事实 ID（按顺序）：fact-scope-obj-01；fact-scope-obj-02；fact-scope-obj-12；fact-scope-obj-03；fact-scope-obj-04
### 4. 事件机制分解
- 本节目标：按推进关系解释事件从异常通信到执行/横向的主链，不逐条重放所有时间点。
- 可引用 packets：verdict_packet；scope_packet
- 优先引用事实 ID（按顺序）：fact-event-evt-303；fact-event-evt-304；fact-event-evt-307；fact-event-evt-309；fact-event-evt-311
### 5. 关键证据与异常事实
- 本节目标：只抓最关键的支撑事实与反证边界，写清它们为什么改变判断。

- 优先引用事实 ID（按顺序）：fact-event-evt-304；fact-event-evt-311；fact-event-evt-307；fact-event-evt-309
### 6. 时序特征与行为模式
- 本节目标：只保留少量关键时间节点，并说明这些节点对判断意味着什么。
- 可引用 packets：verdict_packet；constraint_packet
- 优先引用事实 ID（按顺序）：fact-event-evt-303；fact-event-evt-304；fact-event-evt-307；fact-event-evt-311；fact-event-evt-302
### 7. 传播与关联分析
- 本节目标：说明哪些关联已经进入主判断，哪些扩线结果仍只是候选或边界说明，不要把调查锚点直接写成范围扩大。

- 本节目标：说明已确认受影响范围、已确认异常行为和仍待确认部分之间的区别；如果没有已确认受影响资产，必须写成“当前尚无已确认受影响资产；已观察到的异常行为主要落在调查锚点”，不要使用“影响范围仅限于调查锚点”这类表述。
- 可引用 packets：verdict_packet；scope_packet；action_packet
- 优先引用事实 ID（按顺序）：fact-scope-obj-01；fact-scope-obj-02；fact-scope-obj-12；fact-scope-obj-03；fact-scope-obj-04；fact-event-evt-311；fact-event-evt-309

- 可引用 packets：scope_packet；constraint_packet
- 优先引用事实 ID（按顺序）：fact-gap-expand_cluster_scope

## Writing Priorities
- 第1、2、4、5、7、8、9节默认写成连续短段落，不要把正文写成 fact card 清单。
- 调查锚点、已确认受影响对象、待确认对象、背景指标必须分开表述，不能混写。
- 调查起点资产只写成调查锚点或调查焦点，不写成已确认受影响资产。
- 核心外部基础设施只写成已确认关联基础设施或关键外联对象，不写成已确认受影响范围。
- 第8节如果没有已确认受影响对象，使用“当前尚无已确认受影响资产；已观察到的异常行为主要落在调查锚点”这类句式，不要使用任何“影响范围仅限于调查锚点”的变体。
- 反证只说明为什么它不足以推翻主判断，不要把背景流量写成主结论。

candidate_events.summary: The database server resolved the same rare C2 domain after the SMB connection from web-app-01.
Remote service creation from web-app-01 to app-db-01 appeared after app-db-01 contacted the beacon infrastructure.
Script block logging was disabled on web-app-01, limiting command detail behind the PowerShell launcher.

confirmed_events.summary: Public-facing web server received exploit requests against the login endpoint before external TLS traffic began.
WAF telemetry also showed generic scanner payloads blocked earlier in the same window.
The web server resolved cdn-auth-check.net shortly after the exploit attempts.
Seed JA4 alert matched a possible web-shell beacon over TLS.
The same web server reconnected to the same external infrastructure after the seed alert.
A web-shell file named shell.aspx appeared under /var/www/html/.cache after the exploit traffic.
PowerShell launcher executed under w3wp and reached the same temporary web cache path.
Credential-store access from the web worker account followed the PowerShell launcher.
SMB connection from web-app-01 to app-db-01 followed the web-shell and PowerShell activity.
app-db-01 contacted the original external infrastructure after the lateral movement signal.
web-app-03 also reached the same hosting IP through a scanner telemetry vendor domain.
A planned hotfix deployment started after the suspicious chain and may explain later service restarts.
